selection: First squarefree d in [35,6000] with d = 11 mod 24, h(-d) <= 30, -36d a nonzero square modulo 11, and a prime p = v^2 + 9d in [10000,120000] for the least v >= 1 meeting the bound; require h(-4d)=3h(-d), h(-9d)=2h(-d), h(-36d)=6h(-d)
field_prime_rule: least v for each d before advancing d
primary_prediction: The conductor-2 degree-3 rows have positive incremental full rational rank after the eligible rows from conductors 1 and 3
